a574 ticket comment (CORRECTION 2), MEASURED: "AWS_REGION=us-east-1 only -> Session().region_name is None -> client() raises NoRegionError" and "AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=eu-west-1 -> Session().region_name == 'eu-west-1'"; it names bedrock_model.py:50-51 and config.py:19-20 as inaccurate and to be corrected in this ticket
S7/9249 description: inside the container with only the instance role, `boto3.session.Session().region_name` is None with no AWS_DEFAULT_REGION set
infra/compose/docker-compose.yml:160-161 sets BOTH `AWS_REGION` and `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION` for the opcert service (comment: region 'not auto-discovered inside the container -> set it explicitly')
advisory.finding: The new error message, the runbook, and the pre-existing docstrings all present `AWS_REGION` as a working ambient region source, but on the pinned botocore `AWS_REGION` alone does NOT resolve `Session().region_name` (only `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION` / the profile does). An operator following the guidance to set a bare `AWS_REGION` would still hit the same NoRegionError — the very outage this change exists to make actionable.
advisory.suggested_fix: In the error message and runbook, name `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION` (not `AWS_REGION`) as the standard env source, or state that `AWS_REGION` alone is not honored by this botocore; update the two docstrings the ticket flagged accordingly.
